title: ci(filter): start the ui jobs on a diff confined to an ADR a ui test reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_
Fixes #37935

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改 CI 的触发清单与一个仓内门禁,产品行为前后不变。
- 为什么做:Studio 菜单分组的设计记录与菜单代码之间有一条对齐测试,只改那份设计记录的 PR 以前不会跑这条测试,红灯会落到下一位作者头上。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是只改那份设计记录的 PR 多跑一轮界面测试,或门禁误报一次;直接撤回本 PR 即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么:无;按改动内容判定属可自动合并的档位,席位复核通过后自动合并。

## What changes

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the `filter` job's `ui:` list** gains one row: `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` (Test UI) reads that ADR from the root `docs/adr/` and pins its type-to-group table to the Studio menu code. Before this row a diff confined to the ADR set `ui=false` and `ui_consumers=false`, so no ui job started.
- **`scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`** gains a fifth subject (the card's "pin it the way #27673 did"). `uiRootReadsOf` reads every tracked `ui/**` test file through `scanPathExpressions`, the path walker that `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` already use, so the gate adds no recognizer of its own and keeps no list. It collects each read under the root `docs/adr/`, and `judgeUiReads` checks two things:
  - every such read is covered by a list that the `test-ui` job's `if:` ORs. The lists are read back from the `if:`, which must name `ui`; `ui_consumers` counts too.
  - every `ui:` row under `docs/adr/` still has a ui test that reads it. A row with no reader is reported as a leftover, and the failure text says check, then delete: the walker reads each test file's own text, so a read made inside a module the test imports is not seen. The header names that bound.

  Each read counts only as what it is on disk, the same real-file / real-directory filter `check:cross-package-test-inputs` applies to the walker's answer. The walker puts every bound name in its file set, so a bound-then-listed directory read is classified as a directory (covered by `docs/adr/**`, not by a literal `docs/adr` row). A spelled path that names nothing on disk is a synthetic fixture path, not a read.

  There are five refusals: no tracked ui test, no `test-ui` job, `ui` gone from that `if:`, reads not supplied, reads refused. Self-test battery (12) has 20 cases at a floor of 16. The roster floor goes from 10 to 11.

**Merge group, measured from ci.yml.** On `merge_group` the `ui` output comes from the queue diff (`merge_group.base_sha` against the head), through the same `ui:` list (see the comment above the `ui:` output). The filter step runs on merge_group with `continue-on-error`, and on failure `|| 'true'` runs everything. So the new row starts the ui jobs for an ADR-0084-only entry in the queue too. Before this PR they were skipped there, as they were on the PR.

**Which ui tests a docs/adr-only diff can turn red (measured, tree 3402071c).** I ran the walker over all 7253 tracked ui test files. Exactly one read lands under the root `docs/adr/`: ADR-0084, read by `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`. The other files the card names resolve elsewhere:
- `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` reads `ui/docs/adr/0060-product-neutral-renderer.md`. Its root is `ui/`, so `ui/**` already covers it.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-*.test.ts` read the ui tree's own `docs/adr/` (root `ui/`) or temp fixtures.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts` and `select-type-check-scope.test.ts` only carry `docs/adr/...` as string fixtures.

**Trade-off and choice.** I named the file verbatim rather than adding `docs/adr/**`. With a subtree row, every ADR edit would start the whole ui battery (five jobs, 16 Test UI shards) for the one ADR a ui test reads. With the verbatim row, a new ui test reading another root ADR goes red in `check:ci-filter-parity` and names the row to add. The gate also accepts `docs/adr/**`, if a ruling ever prefers it.

**Once Test UI starts, the selector runs the pin (measured).** `selectAffectedTests({ changed: [], outside: ['docs/adr/0084-…'] })` returns mode `affected` with 525 always-on files. `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` is one of them because its disk read resolves outside every workspace package.

## Tests

<details><summary>check-ci-filter-parity: self-test and real tree (head bd4c3214)</summary>

```text
$ node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs --self-test   EXIT=0
✓ check-ci-filter-parity --self-test: 161 assertions — … and Test UI's root ADR reads: a ui test's ADR read found through the shared walker and observed red by path, covered verbatim, by its subtree and by `ui_consumers`, a directory read needing its subtree, a bound-then-listed directory classified as one, a path not on disk read as nothing, a wildcard row covering nothing, a reader-less row reported as a leftover, five refusals, and the checked-in tree green with the #37935 row dropped observed red through the report path.

$ node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs   EXIT=0
OK: all 1 path(s) under docs/adr read by the 7253 tracked ui test file(s) are covered by `ui` or `ui_consumers`, which the `test-ui` job's `if:` reads, and every `ui` row under those roots still has a reader.
```

The real-tree rollback case removes the new ci.yml row. `judgeUiReads` then reports exactly ADR-0084, and `main()` returns 1. That red-then-green proof runs on the real file inside the self-test.

Ablation of the classification: restoring the old name-set rule in `uiRootReadsOf` on disk turns the self-test red, 2 of 161 (the bound-then-listed read comes back as a `file` row, the not-on-disk path as a read); with the fix restored it is green again.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, not fixed here (reported to the seat for a family card).** The same walker finds other reads outside `ui/` that no ui list covers:
  - `CONTRIBUTING.md` (`ui/scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts`)
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts` (`identityImportFields.endpointColumns-34536.test.ts`)
  - `packages/mcp/src/skill-md` (the Console's `objectstack-skill.test.ts`). ci.yml already records this one as a deliberate trade-off.
  - `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs` (ui selector and plan tests)

  Fixture strings also show up (`elsewhere/x.js`, `scripts/helper.mjs`, `tools/helper.mjs`). Each real gap is a scheduling trade-off, not a missing row, so the new subject is scoped to `docs/adr` as ruled. Its header states that bound.
- **Ledger blind spot (reported).** `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` `deriveCandidates()` accepts a read outside `ui/` only under `content/docs`. So `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`'s ADR read is not in its adjudicated ledger, and that audit cannot see it. That file is outside this card's file surface.
- **Cost (advisory, shared box).** `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` went from about 0.31 s to about 1.5 s, 3 runs each, because the gate now reads 7253 ui test files. It runs inside `Lint & Repo Gates`. No ui job median changes, since only ADR-0084-only diffs start ui jobs that did not start before.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `judgeUiReads`: the whole-name match of `ui` in the `test-ui` `if:` (`ui` is a prefix of `ui_consumers` and `ui_tree`) and the leftover rule.
2. `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `uiRootReadsOf`: the walker call with no package name, and the bound this puts on manifest-name `findUp` reads.
3. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the new `ui:` row and its comment, and the line naming this class of row in the comment above the `ui:` list.

Tier: S by content (ruling 6722205630, letter C), not H.

Two-minute check: run `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs --list | tail -3`. You should see `ok   docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md   via literal …   (ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts)`. Then delete the row from ci.yml, re-run, and the gate exits 1 naming ADR-0084.
